Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

tomorrow — the day after today. Example: Tomorrow I am going to visit my grandmother.
next — the one after this one. Example: Next week I am going to start a course.
week — seven days. Example: Next week I am going to start a course.
plan — an idea about what you will do. Example: I have got a plan for next week.
visit — to go to see a person or place. Example: I am going to visit my grandmother.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I am going to ...
• Tomorrow I am going to ...
• Next week ...
• What are you going to do?
• I have got a plan.

Grammar focus: Be going to for future plans.
